title: feat: add GPT-6 Luna Decisions with OpenAI primary and OpenRouter fallback
author: tomdacatto

gist.summary: Added the Paid-only openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions model for text and JSON decisions, with no alias or Pollinations GPU. It uses OpenAI’s /v1/decisions as primary and OpenRouter’s /api/alpha/decisions as fallback through a shared backend, and supports /alpha/decisions and /v1/chat/completions, including streaming. Input is billed per million tokens; above 272K input tokens, the higher rate applies to the entire request, while output is free. Primary and forced-fallback tests succeeded with 600K input tokens, and eight receipts reconciled wallet charges with usage records. Requests at 900K input tokens returned upstream 504s on both routes without debiting the wallet, so usable capacity at that size remains unconfirmed. Azure’s Decisions routes returned 404 in October 9 checks, and Fireworks did not list Luna.

Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with warm cream and mint tones and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
